why: Both proposals share the same tan leather sofa (not mustard velvet), the same rattan chair and rug, and an etagere that is far too wide and tall to be the low bookcase the client asked for. A is better because its cushions (navy, red and teal woven pattern) and its blue ceramic pots match the rug and the colorful bohemian brief. B's teal medallion cushions fit the palette less well, and its ZZ plants in plain nursery pots miss the requested ceramic planters, so it looks less cohesive.
